verdict.rationale: Numeral's products API lets a developer create and categorize products for tax calculation, and pricing lists AI product classification. Calculations take an address plus a set of products, so line items are taxed according to their product category. However, the evidence never names the category taxonomy, such as SaaS, digital goods, services or physical products, and never shows per-jurisdiction taxability rules applied to those categories. Missing for 10: a documented tax-category list covering SaaS, digital goods, services and physical goods; evidence of per-jurisdiction taxability by category; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can map my catalog to the vendor's tax categories — SaaS, digital goods, services, physical products — so each line item is taxed by what it is, in every jurisdiction it sells

citations.quote: Create and categorize a new product for tax calculation purposes.
Create a product with a POST to `/tax/products`
You'll give us an address and a set of products, and we'll return the accurate tax amount you should charge.
